title: Bent leg - will not close completely
text:
Bent leg - will not close completely. Unfortunately, my table arrived with one bent leg. The table will open and stand relatively flat (slight wobble) but it will not close all the way. This prevents that leg from snapping in place when closed, leaving a 2-3 inch gap at the top and I cant carry it by the handle.
I am so dissappointed because the size, material, weight and ease of open/close of this table is 5 star. It’s a perfect crafting table for me.
I only wish it didnt arrive damaged.
I have already broken down the cardboard so it would be too hard to try to return now.

Update: I cannot find a way to contact the seller. 😞
